2608.28264.title: Finding Where the Buck Stops: An Automated Failure Attribution-Based Reflection Framework for Multi-Agent Collaboration
2608.28264.paper_summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown promise for complex tasks but suffer from high failure rates. Current self-reflection methods for MAS require all agents to reflect upon failure, overlooking a critical reality: failures typically stem from a specific agent leading the task astray, namely the decisive error agent, while others merely fulfill their regular duties. Forcing regular-behaving agents to reflect contaminates their memory with wrong insights. Hence, we propose DoCtOR (Diagnose-then-Correct PPO-enhanced Reflection), a novel reflection framework that enhances multi-agent collaboration. DoCtOR first identifies the decisive error step and decisive error agent through automated failure attribution, then employs counterfactual reasoning to generate a corrected decisive error step, and finally engages only the decisive error agent to produce targeted reflections. Experimental results show DoCtOR achieves 22%, 26%, and 27% improvements over initial success rates on HotPotQA, ChartQAPro, and Mind2Web datasets, outperforming Reflexion, Retroformer, and COPPER. We further establish the generalizability of our diagnose-then-correct paradigm and demonstrate that in low-resource settings, focusing reflection on reasoning steps after the decisive error step achieves comparable quality to reflecting on the complete failure trajectory.
2608.28264.paper_summary_zh: 多代理系統（MAS）由大型語言模型驅動，在複雜任務中顯示出潛力，但卻面臨高失敗率。目前的MAS自我反思方法要求所有代理對失敗進行反思，忽視了一個關鍵現實：失敗通常源於一個特定的代理使任務偏離正軌，即決定性錯誤代理，而其他代理僅僅履行其常規職責。強迫正常行為的代理進行反思會使他們的記憶受到錯誤見解的污染。因此，我們提出了DoCtOR（診斷-然後-修正PPO增強反思），這是一個增強多代理協作的新型反思框架。DoCtOR首先通過自動化失敗歸因識別決定性錯誤步驟和決定性錯誤代理，然後利用反事實推理生成修正的決定性錯誤步驟，最後僅讓決定性錯誤代理參與以產生針對性的反思。實驗結果顯示，DoCtOR在HotPotQA、ChartQAPro和Mind2Web數據集上的初始成功率上分別提高了22%、26%和27%，超越了Reflexion、Retroformer和COPPER。我們進一步確立了我們的診斷-然後-修正範式的普遍性，並展示在低資源環境中，將反思集中在決定性錯誤步驟之後的推理步驟上，能達到與反思完整失敗軌跡相當的質量。
